name: Amagi Miyuki
source: Protagonist of the heaven route and master of the heaven type guardian Ten-Chan. A cheerful, but airheaded girl. She awakens to her guardian abilities during an attack on her school by Egubado and from that moment onward fights to protect what is dear to her.
